data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. Hello. We appreciate your interest in enhanced user activity reporting. Our current audit logs provide basic activity tracking, but for more advanced reporting capabilities, please describe your specific reporting needs and use cases on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting so our analytics team can review your requirements. [T-3478] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
